verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents some built-in event-driven automation of its own: automatic emails to employees when memos or receipts are missing, automated invoice payment and approval flows, and expense policies embedded into the card program. However, there is no documented user-configurable rule builder for defining triggers and actions. Webhooks are only outbound notifications, a developer building block, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented user-definable rules/trigger engine, a catalog of supported event types and actions, any AI-native rule authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Save time collecting memos and receipts by automating emails directly to employees when information is missing.
